narrative.headline: Search Ikyu hotels and ryokan with dated room prices and cancellation details.
narrative.value_prop: Discover Ikyu hotels and ryokan, inspect exact room-plan conditions, and compare offers with honest price and bath distinctions. Compact results preserve Japanese names, source IDs and freshness.
narrative.auth_narrative: Verified public accommodation reads are anonymous and require no API key. Personalized member inventory and coupon eligibility are outside this CLI; final booking stays on Ikyu.

quickstart.comment: Check exact price and cancellation terms.

narrative.when_to_use: Use for Ikyu Japan accommodation discovery, room-plan inspection, compatible offer comparison and explicit date alternatives. Start with search and retrieve detailed offers only for chosen rooms.
anti_triggers: Member account inventory or coupon acquisition
